alternatives: After a card or combination is proposed, each other living player receives one NÖ! opportunity in clockwise order; every played NÖ! restarts such a round after its player, and resolution occurs after a full round of passes.
Only the next player receives a NÖ! opportunity before the proposed action resolves.
assumptions.selected: After a card or combination is proposed, each other living player receives one NÖ! opportunity in clockwise order; every played NÖ! restarts such a round after its player, and resolution occurs after a full round of passes.

alternatives: A successfully resolved Angriff ends the current owed turn and sets the next player's owed turns to exactly two, including when played during an attacked turn.
A successfully resolved Angriff adds two owed turns to the next player, allowing attack stacks to accumulate.
assumptions.selected: A successfully resolved Angriff ends the current owed turn and sets the next player's owed turns to exactly two, including when played during an attacked turn.
